hero.title: Learn English with Lyn
hero.subtitle: Pronunciation, accent, and fluency coaching from an experienced ESL teacher, delivered through guided shadowing practice.

about.pullQuote: If you're serious about improving your English, I'm serious about helping you get there.
about.title: Meet Lyn
about.body:
With over 10 years of experience teaching English as a foreign and second language, Lyn helps non-native speakers communicate with confidence, clarity, and ease.

Based in South Korea, she has coached students from diverse backgrounds to improve their English for work, travel, academic success, and everyday life, specializing in pronunciation, accent improvement, conversational fluency, phrasal verbs, and idioms.

Her practical, student-centered approach goes beyond memorizing grammar and vocabulary. Whether you're preparing for the IELTS or TOEIC, advancing your Business English for meetings and presentations, or building confidence for travel, every lesson is personalized to match your goals, proficiency level, and learning style.
about.testimonialQuote: I've been a student of Lyn's for over two years, and my pronunciation and overall speaking have improved so much. She gives real practice every class and genuinely cares about how I'm progressing.

courses.title: Lyn's Courses
courses.subtitle: Message Lyn to sign up for any of these.

membership.title: Accent Training Membership
membership.description: Lifetime access to Lyn's full accent training curriculum, with personal feedback on your submissions.
membership.benefit1: 30 structured sessions covering pronunciation, reduction, linking & rhythm
membership.benefit2: Personal feedback from Lyn on your recordings
membership.benefit3: Access to the private Fluency Community

accent.title: Standard English Pronunciation and Accent Training
accent.description: A self-paced course covering the seven essential sounds of standard American English pronunciation.
accent.benefit1: R/L, S/Z, and other tricky consonant sounds
accent.benefit2: The schwa sound, word stress, and syllable rhythm
accent.benefit3: Linking sounds and real practice with movie-clip analysis

phrasalVerbs.title: 100 Phrasal Verbs with 60 Mini-Stories
phrasalVerbs.description: Learn the everyday expressions native speakers actually use, through short, memorable stories.
phrasalVerbs.benefit1: Common phrasal verbs and idioms, explained simply
phrasalVerbs.benefit3: Sound more natural in everyday conversation

ipa.title: International Phonetic Alphabet Coaching
ipa.description: 1-on-1 coaching through the IPA symbols, with sample words and meanings for every sound.
ipa.benefit2: Practice the sounds you can't hear correctly yet

shadowing.title: 1-on-1 Shadowing Online Coaching
shadowing.description: Guided shadowing sessions where you repeat real speech in real time to build natural rhythm and fluency.
shadowing.benefit1: Shadow real video and audio clips with Lyn
shadowing.benefit2: Build natural rhythm, stress, and intonation
shadowing.benefit3: Direct feedback on your shadowing technique

coachingPackages.title: 1-on-1 Coaching Packages
coachingPackages.subtitle: Live 50-minute sessions with Lyn, built around your goals.
coachingPackages.cancellationNote: Cancel at least 8 hours before class. Arriving 10-15 minutes late counts as absent, with no refund.

starter.title: Master English Conversation
starter.description: Vocabulary through stories, speaking, listening, reading, and grammar practice, with structured feedback.

intermediate.title: Conversational English, Pronunciation & Accent Training
intermediate.description: Idioms, phrasal verbs, travel and daily-life conversation, and American accent training through movie-clip analysis.

advanced.title: Speak Clear Confident English
advanced.description: The full reduction-sounds curriculum: vowels, consonants, stress, connected speech, diphthongs, triphthongs, shadowing, and movie analysis.

miniCourses.title: Coming Soon
miniCourses.subtitle: Bite-sized courses on specific sounds, launching soon.

vowelsConsonants.title: Vowels and Consonant Sounds
vowelsConsonants.description: The basic pronunciation of the 14 American English vowels and the consonant letters, with example words and meanings.

ipaSymbols.title: International Phonetic Symbols
ipaSymbols.description: The IPA symbols with a list of sample words and their meanings.

diphthongsTriphthongs.title: Diphthongs & Triphthongs Sounds
diphthongsTriphthongs.description: Diphthong and triphthong sounds with a list of words and sentences.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation & Accent
pronunciation.description: Work on the sounds, rhythm, and intonation that make your English easier to understand.

shadowing.title: Shadowing Practice
shadowing.description: Build natural rhythm and fluency by shadowing real video and audio clips.

recording.title: Record & Compare
recording.description: Record yourself right in the browser and compare it side by side with the original.

feedback.title: Feedback From Lyn
feedback.description: Lyn reviews your recordings herself and gives you direct, personal feedback.

community.title: Practice with the Community
community.subtitle: Join The Fluency Community Coach on YouTube and Facebook for free pronunciation tips and weekly practice.

whatIsIt.question: What will I find here?
whatIsIt.answer: Lyn's pronunciation, accent, and fluency courses. Practice by shadowing real speech, recording yourself, and getting her feedback.

coursesAvailable.question: Are Lyn's courses available now?
coursesAvailable.answer: Yes, all of Lyn's courses and coaching packages are available now. Message her to get started.

existingStudent.question: I'm already a student. Where do I sign in?
existingStudent.answer: Use the Sign In link at the top of the page.

paymentOptions.question: Do you have any payment options?
paymentOptions.answer: Payment is currently handled directly with Lyn via PayPal. Get in touch to arrange payment for any course.

refundPolicy.question: What if a course doesn't match my needs? Can I get a refund?
refundPolicy.answer: Courses are digital and delivered right away, so they're non-refundable once purchased. Message Lyn first if you're not sure a course is the right fit, she's happy to help you choose.
